**New Features / Improvements:**

* Added HTTPS tunnel diagnostics with transfer statistics, upstream details, and connection errors.
* Improved application metadata usage by removing more hardcoded product names.

**Bug Fixes:**

* Fixed a potential NullReferenceException during HTTPS tunnel shutdown by safely handling socket disposal when concurrent relay operations terminate.

**Known Issues / Limitations:**

* The Console app does not support saving proxy state across restarts, automatically starting at system login, logging to a file, nor checking for preview release updates. For these features and more, use the Tray app, which is better suited for these things.
* Teams for work or school may disconnect when the proxy is set at the system level. To avoid this issue, it is recommend to set `teams.microsoft.com;*.teams.microsoft.com;teams.cloud.microsoft;*.teams.cloud.microsoft;login.microsoftonline.com` in the system proxy exception list based on a [Microsoft Tech Community Post](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/discussions/teamsdeveloper/when-using-proxy-on-localhost-teams-fails-to-establish-tcp-connection-for-login/4146890). This is also inline with [Microsoft's recommendation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/proxy-servers-for-skype-for-business-online) for not using a proxy server with Teams.
